form.label: LiveWire Cross-Launch
form.description: Choose a LiveWire to perform a forensic search. LiveWires that saw the selected traffic are listed first. Click one of the "open" cells to cross launch.

search.query: | multisearch [search `livewire_netflow` | `livewire_app`] [search `livewire_otlp` | eval exporter_ip='host.ip', src_ip=saddr, dest_ip=daddr, src_port=sport, dest_port=dport, Application=application] | eval hit=if(("$src_ip$"="*" OR src_ip="$src_ip$") AND ("$src_port$"="*" OR tostring(src_port)="$src_port$") AND ("$dest_ip$"="*" OR dest_ip="$dest_ip$") AND ("$dest_port$"="*" OR tostring(dest_port)="$dest_port$") AND ("$app$"="*" OR Application="$app$") AND ($mitre_category|s$="*" OR mitre_category=$mitre_category|s$) AND ($message|s$="*" OR message=$message|s$), 1, 0) | stats sum(hit) AS Matches max(_time) AS last_seen by exporter_ip | addinfo | eval filter=if("$src_ip$"="*", "", " & addr(ip: '$src_ip$')").if("$src_port$"="*", "", " & port($src_port$)").if("$dest_ip$"="*", "", " & addr(ip: '$dest_ip$')").if("$dest_port$"="*", "", " & port($dest_port$)").if("$app$"="*", "", " & app('$app$')") | eval filter=replace(filter, "^ & ", "") | eval filter=replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(filter, "%", "%25"), " ", "%20"), "&", "%26"), "'", "%27"), "\(", "%28"), "\)", "%29"), "\+", "%2B") | eval start=replace(strftime(info_min_time, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%Q%z"), "\+", "%2B"), end=replace(strftime(info_max_time, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%Q%z"), "\+", "%2B") | eval query="startTime=".start."&endTime=".end.if(filter="", "", "&filter=".filter)."&showDialog=true" | eval local_url="http://".exporter_ip."/omnipeek/forensics?".query, distributed_url="http://".exporter_ip."/omnipeek/distributed-forensic-searches/new-distributed-forensic-search?".query | eval Status=if(Matches>0, "Saw this traffic", "Not seen"), "Last seen"=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "Forensic search"="Open", "Distributed forensic search"="Open" | sort -Matches exporter_ip | rename exporter_ip AS LiveWire
